name: U.S. DOT Automated Vehicle Framework, April 2025
known_limitations: The framework states policy direction. It does not itself create every rule, certify a vehicle, validate safety performance, authorize a local service, or establish commercial scale.
automation_notes: Track each named rule, exemption, reporting change, safety action, and implementation record separately.
notes: April 24, 2025 announcement of a federal AV policy framework; downstream actions require their own evidence.
